summary: COSMIC CAT is a 3D browser game where a cat astronaut defends the Solar System from alien invaders while learning how real space missions are designed. It matters because mission design is usually taught through dense documents - we turn it into gameplay. It answers the Space Mission Design Game challenge directly: players fight through eight planets with planet-specific enemies, survive two action minigames, and design a full mission using official NASA resources - mission segments, JPL CML levels, GMAT orbits, the GSFC Mission Design Lab and the Webb Build-It-Yourself flow. In-game fun-fact cards with cited NASA data appear as you play.
details: COSMIC CAT is a 3D browser game where a cat astronaut defends the Solar System from alien invaders while learning how real space missions are designed.HOW IT WORKS- A WebGL 3D renderer draws the world, characters and effects.- A C++ engine compiled to WebAssembly runs the story-mode rules (8 planets x 10 levels, 40/60/90 enemies by difficulty, elites, bosses, spore shooters).- JavaScript orchestrates HUD, input, saves (4 slots), translations (5 languages), minigames and the mission designer.- Two action minigames: Wave Tower (16 levels, boss on wave 5 with aimed cluster spores) and Survival (20 minutes, special elites every 5 minutes, combo boss at 20).- Enemies use a different attack kit per planet (8 kits: radial spray, ground spikes + shockwave, orbiting spikes, aimed cluster spores, spikes around the player, spore rain, aimed cone, fast nova).- The Space Mission Designer walks through JPL Concept Maturity Levels (CML 1-4) and NASA's 4 mission segments (launch, space, ground, user), with orbit Delta-v, launcher, instruments, budget, mass, power and communications checks, and compares the result with a real NASA mission.- Fun-fact cards with cited NASA data appear when entering a planet and meeting elites and bosses for the first time.HOW THE NASA DATA IS USED- Design and Develop Science Missions (mission segments): structures the mission designer's 4 segments.- JPL Concept Maturity Levels (CML 1-4): the designer's progression stages.- GMAT: Delta-v and reference orbit values used in the orbit step.- GSFC Mission Design Lab: study levels and discipline checks in the designer.- Webb Build It Yourself: objective-to-instruments flow of the designer.- Planetary Fact Sheet, NASA Astrobiology and Orbital Debris Program: content of the in-game fun-fact cards, with the source shown on screen.TOOLSVanilla JavaScript/HTML/CSS, WebGL, Web Audio, C++ compiled to WebAssembly (no external libraries), Electron (Windows portable), Capacitor (Android APK), GitHub Pages hosting.OBJECTIVES IN 48 HOURS (ALL ACHIEVED)Playable 3D game; 2 minigames; NASA-based mission designer; per-planet enemy variety; 5 languages; fun-fact cards with sources.LIMITATIONSSingle-player; characters are procedural low-poly (not sculpted); story-mode enemy movement is fixed in the compiled engine; saves are local-only.NEXT STEPSMultiplayer, sculpted 3D models, deeper mission simulator, cloud saves.
